text.p: Hyundai Motor America expects 1997 sales to reach 130,000 units versus 108,468 in 1996, as the Korean automaker's new Tiburon sporty coupe brings in about 18,000 new buyers, a top official said Monday.
Hyundai Motor America is a unit of Hyundai Motor Co Ltd.

Doug Mazza, executive vice president of Hyundai Motor America, said Hyundai believes it is well positioned to take advantage of affordability concerns among middle-class buyers in the United States. The most expensive vehicle Hyundai offers is the Sonata for $19,900.

Mazza, who spoke at a news conference at the North American International Auto Show, said the company will also benefit from a complete replacement of its model lineup over the last two-and-a-half years.
Mazza said labor problems in Korea are not expected to hurt sales in the U.S. because the company ordered a large number of 1997 model year vehicles early.
"Hyundai supplies are very good. We have a substantial number of cars on the ground in the United States," said Mazza.
On Monday, Hyndai unveiled its Tiburon Convertible Concept Car, based on the current Tiburon. Mazza said there are no plans to build the car.
